 Print Maharashtra SSC, HSC time table 2027 expected soon The Maharashtra State Board of Secondary and Higher Secondary Education (MSBSHSE) is expected to release the time table for the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) Class 10 and Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) Class 12 board examinations 2027 soon. According to the tentative schedule, the HSC written examinations will be held from February 8 to March 16, 2027. The SSC written examinations are scheduled to take place from February 15 to March 11, 2027. Once the time table is released, students will be able to check and download the subject-wise examination schedule in PDF format from the official website, mahahsscboard.in. Students appearing for the board examinations should check the official time table carefully for their subject-wise exam dates and timings. The board is yet to release the detailed date sheet, according to the information provided. Maharashtra Class 10, 12 time table 2027: Tentative exam dates
 The tentative schedule for the Maharashtra board examinations is given below: SSC Class 10 examinations: February 15 to March 11, 2027
 HSC Class 12 examinations: February 8 to March 16, 2027
 Students should know that these dates are based on the tentative schedule. They should check the official date sheet for confirmation of subject-wise examination dates and timings. How to download Maharashtra Class 10, 12 time table 2027
 Students can follow these steps to download the date sheet once it is released: Visit the official website, mahahsscboard.in.
 Open the latest notifications or examination section.
 Look for the Maharashtra SSC or HSC time table 2027 link.
 Click on the relevant link to open the date sheet.
 Check the subject-wise examination dates and timings.
 Download the PDF and save it for future reference.
 Maharashtra board exams 2027 : Important instructions for students
 Students should verify their examination dates and timings using the official time table after its release. They should also visit the MSBSHSE website regularly for updates on the examination schedule and other instructions. Candidates are advised to keep a copy of the date sheet so they can plan their preparation according to their subject-wise examination dates.
